meta.mascot_note: config/thumbnail-illustration.md §3 고정 사양 — 미색 원형 머리·머리카락 없음·코 없음·검은 점 눈·짧은 선 입·안경 없음. 감정은 눈썹으로만. 9장 전부 머리는 동일하고 복장·자세·눈썹만 바뀐다(몸은 바뀌고 머리는 안 바뀐다). 머리 크기는 화면 높이의 약 3분의 1로 실사형(55~60%)보다 작다.
meta.gate_note: config/thumbnail-design.md 게이트 A·B·C·D를 9장 전부 통과. 금액은 verified-data.md 실측치만 사용 — 2억→1억 800만원(-9,200만원, -46%) / 298만 7,000원(6·25 장중 최고가) / 1,420,000원(8·10 종가) / 매도 30,900,000원(금감원 민원 사례) / 6월 수출 141조원. 구도 배분은 §4대로 좌우 대비 4장(1·3·4·5), 은유 2장(2·6), 계승 3장(7~9).
meta.ban_note: 이 편 금지 — 백발 노인·관공서·연금 서류 / 실명 반도체 종목 로고 / 매수 권유로 읽힐 상승 화살표. 마스코트는 무연령·무성이므로 「나 같은 사람」 게이트를 복장과 상황으로만 만든다.
meta.prompt_suffix: Style: a bold, high-saturation 2D digital illustration with cel shading and visible brush work — clearly a drawing, never a photograph and never a rendered 3D scene. Warm golden-hour light floods the scene from one side and pushes deep near-black shadow on the other, so the tonal range runs from almost pure black to bright highlight inside the same frame. Colours are vivid and unmixed: warm gold and orange for the winning side, saturated red for loss and danger, saturated green and gold for gain. Every surface holds its own hue at full strength, and every scene has one clear light source casting hard shadow. The environment is drawn in rich detail with solid perspective, but stays an illustration. CHARACTER SHEET, identical in every image: a smooth rounded off-white head with no hair, no nose and no rendered skin texture, two solid black eyes and a drawn mouth; thick black eyebrows carry the emotion together with the mouth, sweat drops, tears, hands and props; never any glasses unless the scene calls for them; the head spans roughly one third of the frame height; only the clothing and posture change between images. Do not render any text other than the Korean and English words explicitly quoted above.
meta.style_note: 2026-08-20 개정 — 첫 회차가 회색·저채도·무표정으로 나와 경제해적단 실측(채도 0.34~0.54 / 대비 0.96~1.00)에 맞춰 스타일을 전면 교체했다. 규칙 원본: channels/bangguseok-economy/config/thumbnail-illustration.md §2·§3

thumbnails.concept_ko: 오프닝 5단 ③ '같은 날 같은 반도체를 산 두 사람'을 마스코트 두 몸으로 세웠다. 갈린 변수는 종목이 아니라 빌린 돈이다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 아바타 2인(무연령·무성) [B 금액] 좌 표지판 "1억 800만원", 우 표지판 "0원" [C 사건] 오른쪽 발밑 지면이 지금 갈라져 내려앉는 중 [D 주어] 두 결말 모두 내 계좌다 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목의 어구를 옮기지 않고 결과 숫자만 맡는다
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real place — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark foreground ground and the deep shadow the two figures cast toward the viewer, drawn dark, soft and free of detail so it reads as one single dark mass, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No head, no hand, no sign and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, hand, signboard and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The signboards and the horizon run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast: strong golden light on one side, deep near-black shadow on the other, vivid unmixed colour throughout — the dark bottom band must not spread upward into it. SIZE: each mascot head spans roughly one third of the frame height and sits in the upper five-eighths, and the detailed world stays fully readable around them. Scene: a fork in a road at dawn on the edge of a Korean industrial town, seen straight on at standing eye level, the two branches separating around a wooden signpost planted in the middle of the frame. The left branch is dry, level and lit by warm early sunlight; the mascot standing there wears a clean deep blue-black work shirt with the sleeves rolled, and the plank beside it reads "1억 800만원" in Korean Hangul burnt into the wood. The right branch is a cold blue-deep blue-black slope where the asphalt has split open and is collapsing downward at this very moment, chunks of road tilting into the crack; the mascot standing on it wears a worn padded jacket with one pocket torn, and its plank reads "0원" in Korean Hangul. Both mascots are drawn to the identical character sheet and stand at the same height on either side of the post. Left mascot: eyebrows flat and level, both hands loose at its sides. Right mascot: eyebrows steeply angled down at the outer ends into a sharp inverted V of dismay, one arm thrown out for balance as the ground gives way, the other clutching a folded paper against its chest. Its mouth hangs open in a small horrified O, the dot eyes are drawn large and round with white showing, and one hand is clamped flat on top of its head.

Scene: the concrete stairwell of an old Korean commercial building seen straight on at standing eye level, drawn with convincing materials — chipped paint, a steel handrail with rust bleeding from the bolts, a bare bulb, a fire hose cabinet, a taped notice on the wall. The mascot is climbing and has just reached the middle of the flight in a plain jacket with a canvas bag across its body, but the three steps directly beneath its feet have cracked and are breaking away right now, slabs of concrete tipping and dropping into the dark below while dust hangs in the light. A fabric banner hangs along the wall beside the stairs: its top line reads "반대매매 안내" in large Korean Hangul, its smaller second line reads "Forced Liquidation Notice" in English, and the figure "3,090만원" is printed in red Korean Hangul at its end. The mascot's eyebrows are pulled into an asymmetric shape, one shooting up and the other driven down, one hand has locked onto the handrail with the fingers wrapped hard around it while the other is still raised in mid-stride, and its body is tilted backward off balance. Its mouth is wrenched open to one side, a big sweat drop hangs at its temple, and one hand is pressed flat against its forehead.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 사상 최고가를 적어 붙인 종이가 유리에 그대로 붙어 있는데, 그 앞에 선 사람의 계좌는 이미 절반이다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 좌 3분의 1 인물과 우 3분의 2 현장을 가르는 수직 경계 · 카메라는 현장 바깥 인도에 서서 정면으로 본다(시점 유지) · 인물은 좌측에서 정면을 담담히 응시 · 배경 소품(유리에 붙은 손글씨 종이)이 정보 장치다 / [바꿈] 피사체(세계적 부호 1인 → 앞치마 차림의 마스코트 자영업자) · 업종·장소(낮의 낡은 부동산 골목 → 증권사 지점 유리창 앞) · 관찰 디테일(매물 안내지 → 떼어지는 중인 최고가 종이와 창턱의 식은 종이컵) ‖ [A 얼굴] 마스코트 아바타 [B 금액] 손글씨 종이 "298만 7,000" [C 사건] 직원이 지금 그 종이를 떼어내는 중 [D 주어] 저 값에 산 게 내 돈이다 [구도] 인물+현장 결합 [텍스트] 제목 어구 비복제 ※ 마스코트 머리는 9장 동일, 인물 구분은 복장·자세·눈썹으로만 한다
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real place — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark shadowed pavement running along the shopfront and the figure's near shoulder, drawn dark, soft and free of detail so it reads as one single dark mass, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No head, no hand, no sheet and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The window sill and the counters inside run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast: strong golden light on one side, deep near-black shadow on the other, vivid unmixed colour throughout — the dark bottom band must not spread upward into it. SIZE: the mascot head spans roughly one third of the frame height and sits in the upper five-eighths on the left, and the detailed shopfront stays fully readable across the right two-thirds. Scene: drawn from the pavement outside a small securities branch on a low commercial street under a flat golden-hour sky, viewed straight on at standing eye level; the mascot occupies the left third and the full width of the shop window fills the right two-thirds, the window frame forming the vertical divide. Taped to the inside of that glass is a single sheet with a number written large by hand in marker, reading "298만 7,000" in Korean Hangul, its edges curled and sun-faded; a staff mascot in a branch vest has taken hold of one corner and is peeling it off right now, its arm raised at mid height. Behind it the waiting chairs stand empty in a row, half the ceiling lights are off, and the warm amber-brown interior shows a paper cup gone cold on the sill and a dark unlit monitor. The foreground mascot wears a black apron over a checked shirt and stands square to the viewer in front of the glass. Its eyebrows are flat, low and completely level, its short line mouth is drawn straight, and both hands hang loose at its sides with the fingers slightly curled — the calm of someone who has already understood. Its mouth is a hard straight line pressed thin, the dot eyes are narrowed to slits, and both fists are clenched tight at its sides.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real place — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark wet pavement below the window and the figure's near shoulder, drawn dark, soft and free of detail so it reads as one single dark mass, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No head, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, hand, screen and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The window sill and the desk inside run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast: strong golden light on one side, deep near-black shadow on the other, vivid unmixed colour throughout — the dark bottom band must not spread upward into it. SIZE: the mascot head spans roughly one third of the frame height and sits in the upper five-eighths on the left, and the detailed shopfront stays fully readable across the right two-thirds. Scene: drawn from the pavement outside the same small securities branch late at night, viewed straight on at standing eye level; the mascot occupies the left third and the shop window fills the right two-thirds. Inside, one desk lamp and a row of cool fluorescent tubes are still burning and a large monitor faces the street: it reads "총평가금액" in Korean Hangul across the top and "1억 800만원" in red Korean Hangul characters underneath, the white and red light smearing across the rain-wet glass together with the reflection of a street lamp. The rest of the interior is dark and stopped — chairs pushed in, a jacket left over a chair back, a mug on the desk. The mascot stands close to the glass in a quilted cardigan with a shopping bag looped over its wrist, its own phone lighting up in its lowered hand at mid frame height. Its eyebrows slope down only shallowly at the outer ends and sit heavy, its short line mouth is drawn a touch shorter with the ends level, its head is tipped very slightly up to hold the viewer's gaze, and its free hand has gathered the end of its scarf into a fist at its chest. Its mouth sags open at one corner, one heavy tear sits at the edge of an eye, and the free hand is pressed flat against the glass.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real place — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark shadowed floor tiles of the arcade and the figure's near shoulder, drawn dark, soft and free of detail so it reads as one single dark mass, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No head, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The machine's keypad shelf runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast: strong golden light on one side, deep near-black shadow on the other, vivid unmixed colour throughout — the dark bottom band must not spread upward into it. SIZE: the mascot head spans roughly one third of the frame height and sits in the upper five-eighths on the left, and the detailed arcade stays fully readable across the right two-thirds. Scene: drawn inside the ground-floor arcade of an old Korean traditional market on an golden-hour afternoon, viewed straight on at standing eye level; the mascot occupies the left third and a glass-fronted self-service banking booth fills the right two-thirds. The machine's screen glows at mid frame height showing "매도체결" in Korean Hangul on the upper line and "30,900,000" in large red digits below, and a printed slip is halfway out of the slot, curling as it feeds. Taped to the glass beside the machine is an older handwritten sheet, sun-bleached and rippled, still reading "298만 7,000" in Korean Hangul. Market texture surrounds them — folded cardboard stacked against a pillar, a hand truck, a strip of plastic curtain, worn floor tiles, small mascot shoppers passing far behind at a much smaller scale. The foreground mascot wears a navy work jacket with the sleeves pushed up and holds a cap in one hand. It is drawing the back of its wrist across its forehead mid-motion, one eyebrow lifted high while the other stays low in a lopsided joyless expression, and its dot eyes hold the viewer steadily. Its mouth twists open in a lopsided grimace, a sweat drop slides down one side, and one hand is dragged slowly down its own face.
